overall: The AG found a violation for failing to create and approve minutes of the July 16, 2011 meeting, found no violation for lack of individual notice to homeowners, could not determine March 23, 2012 posting compliance, and declined two allegations.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board met and acted without posting notice; the letter assumed this referred to the March 23, 2012 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, even if the notice was not properly posted, the Board took appropriate remedial action in response to the complaint by nullifying the action taken during the March 23, 2013 meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to create and keep minutes of its July 16, 2011 meeting and the decisions made there.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law, and order the Board, to the best of its ability, to create and approve minutes for its July 16, 2011 meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board discussed actions against a homeowner without giving the homeowner adequate individual notice to attend.
allegations.key_passage: Thus, the Open Meeting Law did not require the Board to provide the Wise Family with individual notice of its meetings, even when property owned by the Wise Family was being discussed.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged an unposted Board meeting on February 21, 2012, when two members visited a property with the building inspector and no minutes were kept.
allegations.key_passage: Thus, even if this allegation had been raised in the initial complaint, it was untimely.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged Board members discussed actions without due process, a claim under laws other than the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: This determination concerns only compliance with the Open Meeting Law, G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25, thus we decline to review allegations of violation of any other laws.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Create and approve complete and accurate minutes for the July 16, 2011 meeting, to the best of the Board's ability, within sixty days of receipt, and certify compliance to the AG's office.
remedy_passage: We order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
